description: This file defines the SearchEntry class, which models a search result entry containing a product index and highlight information for search display.

classes.name: SearchEntry
classes.description: Represents a search result entry with a product index and highlighting details.

methods.name: setHighlights
methods.description: Sets the list of highlight snippets for this search entry.

methods.name: getHighlights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of highlight snippets associated with this search entry.

methods.name: setIndexProduct
methods.description: Assigns the indexed product details to this search entry.

methods.name: getIndexProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the indexed product details associated with this search entry.
